📋 Owner Portal Rules

• Keep owner contact details and property instructions together.

• Record whether the marketing agreement is signed or pending.

• A property can be marketed only after the owner's approval is recorded.

• Use the owner contact button for direct communication.

This is a local management record. It does not send information to social networks or request account permissions.

📣 Property Marketing

Status: Draft
Select a property to generate a social-media post.

🔐 Approval workflow

① Property saved → ② Blue World generates post → ③ You review → ④ You approve → ⑤ Share/post through connected social accounts.

Blue World will not treat a draft as approved. Social-account posting requires the relevant account connection and permissions.

🚀 Broker growth checklist

☑ Get owner's permission & commission agreement

☑ Add accurate price, location and availability

☑ Generate platform-specific content

☑ Approve before publishing

☑ Record every inquiry as a lead

☑ Follow up and record viewing/negotiation stage

Suggested channels

🎵 TikTok · 📸 Instagram · 📘 Facebook · 💬 WhatsApp Status

Always get the owner's permission before publishing property photos, prices or contact details.
